lines.text: John sees seven angels with the final plagues, and victors by a sea of glass sing the song of Moses and the Lamb.
Seven angels leave the temple and receive seven golden trumpets full of God's wrath from one of the four living creatures.
The first three bowls bring sores on those with the beast's mark and turn the sea and rivers to blood.
The sixth angel dries up the river Jordan to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
The seventh angel pours his bowl into the air, a voice says "It is done," and a great earthquake splits the great city.
